summary: Off-registry HTTPS tarball dependency pulls unpinned code on install
details: package.json declares a single dependency `ltidisafe` whose value is a direct HTTPS tarball URL (https://ltidi.storage.googleapis.com/depenconf/ltidisafe-4.0.7.tgz) on a third-party Google Cloud Storage bucket, not a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches and installs whatever bytes that URL returns and runs any lifecycle scripts inside the fetched tarball, with no version pin and no integrity check. The shipped index.js is an empty stub, so the manifest line is the entire installer-facing surface of the package. The implausibly high version (99.9.1) and the bucket path segment `depenconf` are consistent with a dependency-confusion dropper staged to win resolution against an internal package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
